title: Keto Slovakian Stew
description: A hearty Slovakian-inspired stew made with tripe, kissed potatoes, and served with a side of butter. This recipe is designed to be low-carb and keto-friendly.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the tripe and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the kissed potatoes, Slovakian stew seasoning, and enough water to cover the ingredients.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hour.
Stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
